# Wholesale Builder Beam

> Trade-only supplier of reclaimed-look box beams for home builders, general contractors and remodelers. Beams are built to order in your height, width and length, prestained to your stain spec or unfinished, and shipped by crated freight across the lower 48 states. Oklahoma Made.

## What we offer
- Three-sided reclaimed-look box beams
- Heights and widths of 4, 6, 8, 10 or 12 inches (larger sizes quoted on request)
- Lengths up to 24 ft per piece; multiple lengths per order
- Prestained to your stain brand, type and color, or unfinished for your painter or finisher
- Crated LTL freight anywhere in the lower 48, local delivery within about 100 road miles of Norman, Oklahoma, or pickup near Norman
- Bulk and repeat orders for builders; resale permit details accepted on the order form

## Pricing
Trade pricing is per linear foot by size and finish and is quote-based. The order form shows an estimate; the final quote and freight are confirmed before payment.

## How to order
1. Fill out the order form at https://wholesalebuilderbeam.com/#order with contact and company, beam size, lengths, finish and delivery ZIP.
2. The form estimates freight from the delivery ZIP.
3. Press Place order. We confirm freight and lead time, then send a secure payment link. No card is charged on the order page.

## Key pages
- [Home and order form](https://wholesalebuilderbeam.com/): Product details and the order form
- Design inspiration on the home page is a set of licensed reference photographs of other rooms with exposed wood beams. Those photos are not Wholesale Builder Beam installations, product photos, or finish samples.
- [Sizing and spec guide](https://wholesalebuilderbeam.com/sizing.html): Beam sizes, construction, finishes, freight and ordering for builders
- [Builder FAQ](https://wholesalebuilderbeam.com/faq.html): What box beams are, mounting, measuring, finishes, sizes, delivery, lead time and how to order
- [Install guide](https://wholesalebuilderbeam.com/install.html): How decorative three-sided box beams are received, mounted over a cleat or blocking, cut or butted on site, and finished. General trade overview for builders. Beams are decorative and non-structural.
- [Bid spec and takeoff guide](https://wholesalebuilderbeam.com/specify.html): What to list on a takeoff or bid before ordering decorative box beams: height, width, piece lengths and quantities, finish, and delivery or pickup. Guidance for builders, GCs and remodelers. Beams are decorative and non-structural. Not a stamped specification or an engineer letter.
- [Wrap an existing beam](https://wholesalebuilderbeam.com/wrap.html): How to plan covering an existing beam line or framing with a decorative three-sided open-top box beam for appearance. Measure the beam line, choose a listed size that will cover it, then order. General trade overview for builders, GCs and remodelers. Beams are decorative and non-structural. The existing structure stays load-bearing. Not a stamped specification, engineer letter, or stamped install instruction.
- [Prestained or unfinished](https://wholesalebuilderbeam.com/finish.html): How to choose prestained or unfinished decorative box beams and how to enter the stain brand, type and color on the order. Guidance for home builders, GCs and remodelers. Not a finish sample, a color-match guarantee, or a stamped specification.
